pipeline: bounded source parse -> typed A Program -> bounded structural CoreProgram copy -> owner admit/admit_run -> unstepped ProgramView/genesis projection
occurrence_binding: source function_index/child_path -> owner occurrence owner_is_function/function/path; complete preparation/provenance and ProgramView remain separate fields
declared_scope: All supported Program/Function, Expr operator families, patterns and dedicated sorts; no generic ADT or financial grammar is added

obligations.returned_values: Preserve closed entry, original function table and the eventual entry value.
obligations.defined_failures: Keep parse/type/copy/owner admission diagnostics separate from runtime Outcome.
obligations.order: Retain entry-preorder owner occurrence IDs and original function-table order.

obligations.returned_values: Preserve names, parameter sorts/order, declared return sort and body.
obligations.defined_failures: Preserve first declaration lookup and runtime bind/return failures 8/6 on applicable common-domain states; preparation typing may reject earlier.
obligations.order: Check every body in original order before entry; do not unroll recursive calls.

obligations.returned_values: Preserve UInt128, Bool and nil literals; construct other List/Tree values via existing constructors.
obligations.defined_failures: Public UInt overflow is a source UIntLiteral diagnostic; no typed-domain runtime literal failure is invented.
obligations.order: Preserve each structural occurrence and literal constant identity/order.

obligations.returned_values: Preserve exact lexical lookup value and sort.
obligations.defined_failures: Name the unknown-variable diagnostic and common-domain runtime missing-variable code3 separately.
obligations.order: Search the same saved lexical environment; structural sharing is not name equality.

obligations.returned_values: Preserve bound value, shadowing, body value and restored caller environment.
obligations.defined_failures: Preserve first value/body failure without inventing a successful binding.
obligations.order: Evaluate value before body; body sees the new binding; restore saved scope.

obligations.returned_values: Preserve Bool-directed selected branch value.
obligations.defined_failures: Preserve condition failure and runtime non-Bool condition code5 where applicable; do not execute the unselected branch.
obligations.order: Condition first, then only selected branch at runtime; static checker still checks both branches.

obligations.returned_values: Preserve named recursive call result and declared return sort; no evaluated-literal substitution.
obligations.defined_failures: Name missing function7, binding8 and return-sort6 on applicable runtime states; phase diagnostics remain distinct.
obligations.order: Strict left-to-right arguments, first matching declaration, ordered parameter binding and caller restoration.

obligations.returned_values: Preserve selected arm value and saved-environment extension.
obligations.defined_failures: Preserve scrutinee/selected-body failures and no-matching-arm code9; preparation EmptyMatch is distinct.
obligations.order: Scrutinee first; try source arms in order and execute the first matching arm only.

obligations.returned_values: Exact checked UInt128 sum.
obligations.defined_failures: Preserve checked arithmetic error10 and invalid operand-sort error11 on applicable runtime states.
obligations.order: Strict left-to-right operand evaluation; both operand inference steps precede static sort requirements.

obligations.returned_values: Exact checked UInt128 difference.
obligations.defined_failures: Preserve checked arithmetic error10 and invalid operand-sort error11 on applicable runtime states.
obligations.order: Strict left-to-right operand evaluation; both operand inference steps precede static sort requirements.

obligations.returned_values: Exact checked UInt128 product.
obligations.defined_failures: Preserve checked arithmetic error10 and invalid operand-sort error11 on applicable runtime states.
obligations.order: Strict left-to-right operand evaluation; both operand inference steps precede static sort requirements.

obligations.returned_values: Structural Bool equality across all dedicated sorts, including unequal sorts.
obligations.defined_failures: No equal-sort precondition is added; preserve failures from either operand.
obligations.order: Strict left-to-right operand evaluation; both operand inference steps precede static sort requirements.

obligations.returned_values: UInt128 less-than Bool.
obligations.defined_failures: Preserve invalid operand-sort error11 and earlier operand failures on applicable runtime states.
obligations.order: Strict left-to-right operand evaluation; both operand inference steps precede static sort requirements.

obligations.returned_values: Preserve head UInt and the ordered tail List.
obligations.defined_failures: Preserve invalid operand-sort error11 and earlier operand failures on applicable runtime states.
obligations.order: Strict left-to-right operand evaluation; both operand inference steps precede static sort requirements.

obligations.returned_values: Preserve ordered left/right Tree children.
obligations.defined_failures: Preserve invalid operand-sort error11 and earlier operand failures on applicable runtime states.
obligations.order: Strict left-to-right operand evaluation; both operand inference steps precede static sort requirements.

obligations.returned_values: Preserve the UInt payload as a Tree Leaf.
obligations.defined_failures: Preserve operand failures and invalid operand-sort error11 on applicable runtime states.
obligations.order: Evaluate the operand before the unary operation.

obligations.returned_values: Preserve Bool negation.
obligations.defined_failures: Preserve operand failures and invalid operand-sort error11 on applicable runtime states.
obligations.order: Evaluate the operand before the unary operation.

obligations.returned_values: Bind the entire scrutinee value and its sort.
obligations.defined_failures: A miss continues to the next arm; duplicate Cons/Branch binders remain a miss at runtime and a distinct preparation diagnostic.
obligations.order: Preserve arm order, binder order, saved environment and first-match selection.

obligations.returned_values: Match exactly the empty List.
obligations.defined_failures: A miss continues to the next arm; duplicate Cons/Branch binders remain a miss at runtime and a distinct preparation diagnostic.
obligations.order: Preserve arm order, binder order, saved environment and first-match selection.

obligations.returned_values: Match nonempty List and bind ordered UInt head/List tail.
obligations.defined_failures: A miss continues to the next arm; duplicate Cons/Branch binders remain a miss at runtime and a distinct preparation diagnostic.
obligations.order: Preserve arm order, binder order, saved environment and first-match selection.

obligations.returned_values: Match Tree Leaf and bind its UInt payload.
obligations.defined_failures: A miss continues to the next arm; duplicate Cons/Branch binders remain a miss at runtime and a distinct preparation diagnostic.
obligations.order: Preserve arm order, binder order, saved environment and first-match selection.

obligations.returned_values: Match Tree Branch and bind ordered left/right Trees.
obligations.defined_failures: A miss continues to the next arm; duplicate Cons/Branch binders remain a miss at runtime and a distinct preparation diagnostic.
obligations.order: Preserve arm order, binder order, saved environment and first-match selection.

obligations.returned_values: Preserve dedicated UInt sort, constructor membership and declared argument/return typing.
obligations.defined_failures: Distinguish static Expected diagnostics, runtime bind/return/operand failures and owner Tooling.
obligations.order: Preserve parameter/return/constructor field order; no generic nominal ADT encoding is substituted.

obligations.returned_values: Preserve dedicated Bool sort, constructor membership and declared argument/return typing.
obligations.defined_failures: Distinguish static Expected diagnostics, runtime bind/return/operand failures and owner Tooling.
obligations.order: Preserve parameter/return/constructor field order; no generic nominal ADT encoding is substituted.

obligations.returned_values: Preserve dedicated List sort, constructor membership and declared argument/return typing.
obligations.defined_failures: Distinguish static Expected diagnostics, runtime bind/return/operand failures and owner Tooling.
obligations.order: Preserve parameter/return/constructor field order; no generic nominal ADT encoding is substituted.

resources.a_clock: sherlock-k-a/1: one charge per charged machine rule; terminal publication zero; pure helpers and allocation unmetered
resources.b_clock: sherlock-helper-microstep/1: consumed_work, helper_work, helper_visits and reference_cursor are distinct observations
resources.helper_mapping: Explicitly align/hide Scalar, EnvGet, EnvPut, Find, Bind, Append, Validate, Equal and Match visits and bookkeeping against reference boundaries
resources.same_fuel: not-claimed: equal source values do not imply equal A/B fuel or helper schedules
resources.failure_classes: Parse/type/copy/Tooling preparation refusals, HostViolation, semantic errors, frame-cap/resource rejection4 and fuel/capacity exhaustion remain distinct
resources.required_comparison: Compare complete returned values, defined failures, order and resource prefixes under explicit caller extents; compile-only tables do not observe those runtime prefixes
resources.unmeasured: Physical host time/heap/stack, circuit rows/degree, proof/key size and ledger fees are not inferred

finance.effects: not-applicable in this grammar/profile; no transfers/fees are represented
finance.residual_duties: not-applicable in this grammar/profile; no liabilities/wait/resume are represented

proof.gap: No source-to-B semantic proof or B-to-Clean/handwritten circuit correspondence/native exporter is supplied; host evaluation cannot supply missing circuit evidence
